import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 20;
    static final int MAX_P = 400;
    static final int MAX_R = 200000;
    static final int INF_VAL = 199999999;

    static int[][] grid = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[] dist_src = new int[MAX_P];
    static int[] spfa_q = new int[MAX_P];
    static int[] in_spfa = new int[MAX_P];
    static int[][] dist_all = new int[MAX_P][MAX_P];
    static int size_n, total_pts, time_max;
    static String line_data;
    static int src_row, src_col;
    static int[] rd = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] cd = {-1, 1, 0, 0};

    static class FlowArc {
        int from, to, cap, link;
        FlowArc(int from, int to, int cap, int link) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.link = link;
        }
    }

    static FlowArc[] arc = new FlowArc[MAX_R];
    static int[] head = new int[MAX_P];
    static int arc_idx;
    static int source_id, sink_id;
    static List<Integer> source_points = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer> dest_points = new ArrayList<>();

    static int coord_to_id(int r, int c) {
        return (r-1) * size_n + c;
    }

    static boolean within_bounds(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 1 && r <= size_n && c >= 1 && c <= size_n && grid[r][c] != -1;
    }

    static void construct_distance_graph() {
        total_pts = size_n * size_n;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_P; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_P; j++) {
                dist_all[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        for (int r = 1; r <= size_n; r++) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= size_n; c++) {
                if (grid[r][c] == -1) continue;
                int u = coord_to_id(r, c);
                dist_all[u][u] = 0;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int nr = r + rd[d];
                    int nc = c + cd[d];
                    if (within_bounds(nr, nc)) {
                        int v = coord_to_id(nr, nc);
                        dist_all[u][v] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void spfa_bfs() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= total_pts; i++) dist_src[i] = INF_VAL;
        int f = 0, r = 0;
        int start_id = coord_to_id(src_row, src_col);
        dist_src[start_id] = 0;
        spfa_q[r++] = start_id;
        while (f < r) {
            int u = spfa_q[f++];
            for (int v = 1; v <= total_pts; v++) {
                if (dist_all[u][v] == 1 && dist_src[v] > dist_src[u] + 1) {
                    dist_src[v] = dist_src[u] + 1;
                    spfa_q[r++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void floyd_all_pairs() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= total_pts; k++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= total_pts; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= total_pts; j++) {
                    if (dist_all[i][k] != -1 && dist_all[k][j] != -1) {
                        if (dist_all[i][j] == -1 || dist_all[i][j] > dist_all[i][k] + dist_all[k][j]) {
                            dist_all[i][j] = dist_all[i][k] + dist_all[k][j];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void build_flow_network() {
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        arc_idx = 0;
        source_id = 0;
        sink_id = source_points.size() / 3 + dest_points.size() / 3 + 1;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < source_points.size(); i += 3) {
            int cnt = source_points.get(i+2);
            arc[arc_idx] = new FlowArc(source_id, (int)(i/3)+1, cnt, head[source_id]);
            head[source_id] = arc_idx++;
            arc[arc_idx] = new FlowArc((int)(i/3)+1, source_id, 0, head[(int)(i/3)+1]);
            head[(int)(i/3)+1] = arc_idx++;
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < dest_points.size(); i += 3) {
            int cnt = dest_points.get(i+2);
            arc[arc_idx] = new FlowArc((int)(source_points.size()/3) + (int)(i/3)+1, sink_id, cnt, head[(int)(source_points.size()/3) + (int)(i/3)+1]);
            head[(int)(source_points.size()/3) + (int)(i/3)+1] = arc_idx++;
            arc[arc_idx] = new FlowArc(sink_id, (int)(source_points.size()/3) + (int)(i/3)+1, 0, head[sink_id]);
            head[sink_id] = arc_idx++;
        }
        
        int src_pos = coord_to_id(src_row, src_col);
        for (int i = 0; i < source_points.size(); i += 3) {
            int sr = source_points.get(i), sc = source_points.get(i+1);
            int sp = coord_to_id(sr, sc);
            for (int j = 0; j < dest_points.size(); j += 3) {
                int dr = dest_points.get(j), dc = dest_points.get(j+1);
                int dp = coord_to_id(dr, dc);
                if (dist_all[sp][dp] != -1 && dist_all[sp][dp] <= time_max) {
                    if (dist_all[sp][dp] < dist_src[dp]) {
                        arc[arc_idx] = new FlowArc((int)(i/3)+1, (int)(source_points.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1, INF_VAL, head[(int)(i/3)+1]);
                        head[(int)(i/3)+1] = arc_idx++;
                        arc[arc_idx] = new FlowArc((int)(source_points.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1, (int)(i/3)+1, 0, head[(int)(source_points.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1]);
                        head[(int)(source_points.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1] = arc_idx++;
                    } else if (dist_all[sp][dp] == dist_src[dp]) {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nr = dr + rd[d];
                            int nc = dc + cd[d];
                            if (within_bounds(nr, nc)) {
                                int np = coord_to_id(nr, nc);
                                if (dist_all[sp][np] == dist_all[sp][dp] - 1 && dist_all[sp][np] < dist_src[np]) {
                                    arc[arc_idx] = new FlowArc((int)(i/3)+1, (int)(source_points.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1, INF_VAL, head[(int)(i/3)+1]);
                                    head[(int)(i/3)+1] = arc_idx++;
                                    arc[arc_idx] = new FlowArc((int)(source_points.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1, (int)(i/3)+1, 0, head[(int)(source_points.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1]);
                                    head[(int)(source_points.size()/3) + (int)(j/3)+1] = arc_idx++;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] level_node = new int[MAX_P];
    static int[] bfs_q2 = new int[MAX_P];

    static boolean build_level_graph() {
        Arrays.fill(level_node, -1);
        int f = 0, r = 0;
        bfs_q2[r++] = source_id;
        level_node[source_id] = 0;
        while (f < r) {
            int u = bfs_q2[f++];
            for (int e = head[u]; e != -1; e = arc[e].link) {
                int v = arc[e].to;
                if (level_node[v] == -1 && arc[e].cap > 0) {
                    level_node[v] = level_node[u] + 1;
                    if (v == sink_id) return true;
                    bfs_q2[r++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int[] dfs_path = new int[MAX_P];
    static int[] curr_arc = new int[MAX_P];

    static int dinic_dfs(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == sink_id) return flow;
        for (int i = curr_arc[u]; i != -1; i = arc[i].link) {
            curr_arc[u] = arc[i].link;
            int v = arc[i].to;
            if (level_node[v] == level_node[u] + 1 && arc[i].cap > 0) {
                int push = dinic_dfs(v, Math.min(flow, arc[i].cap));
                if (push > 0) {
                    arc[i].cap -= push;
                    arc[i ^ 1].cap += push;
                    return push;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int compute_max_flow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (build_level_graph()) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= sink_id; i++) curr_arc[i] = head[i];
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dinic_dfs(source_id, INF_VAL);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static int compute_result() {
        grid[src_row][src_col] = 0;
        construct_distance_graph();
        spfa_bfs();
        grid[src_row][src_col] = -1;
        construct_distance_graph();
        floyd_all_pairs();
        build_flow_network();
        return compute_max_flow();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        size_n = scanner.nextInt();
        time_max = scanner.nextInt();
        source_points.clear();
        dest_points.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(grid[i], 0);
        }
        
        scanner.nextLine(); // consume newline
        for (int i = 1; i <= size_n; ++i) {
            line_data = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < size_n; ++j) {
                if (line_data.charAt(j) == 'Y') grid[i][j+1] = -1;
                else if (line_data.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    src_row = i; src_col = j+1;
                    grid[i][j+1] = -1;
                }
                else if (line_data.charAt(j) > '0' && line_data.charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    source_points.add(i);
                    source_points.add(j+1);
                    source_points.add(line_data.charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= size_n; ++i) {
            line_data = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < size_n; ++j) {
                if (line_data.charAt(j) > '0' && line_data.charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    dest_points.add(i);
                    dest_points.add(j+1);
                    dest_points.add(line_data.charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(compute_result());
    }
}
